expectations: A later deposit cannot finance an earlier withdrawal.
Deposits may finance later withdrawals, with exact exhaustion/recreation accepted.
Reject nonfinite/negative touched owners, nonfinite proposals and arithmetic overflow before any state mutation.
Reject a twofold overdraw at 1e-18 without an absolute-mole allowance.
Preserve all positive unrelated inventory and partial remainders, including the smallest positive subnormal.
Preserve separate tiny bulk portions across exhaustion of a larger portion.
Uniform inventory limiting respects the first depleted prefix.
arithmetic_policy: Prefix arithmetic allowance at most eight binary64 epsilons times the larger local amount/request; no fixed absolute-mole allowance. This is not compensated ownership or a bulk-plus-tiny guarantee.
limitations: Source-informed controls, not new independently forecast CLI cases.
Scope: ordered amount changes and positive trace preservation; not whole-state/snapshot/thermal certification.
pre_execution_extension: Before production changes and either hosted execution, added nonfinite-request and explicit inside/outside roundoff controls: one ULP exhaustion may clamp to zero, 64 ULP overdraw must refuse. Original controls unchanged.
